short_description: Trader Joe's plans a second Plano store at the corner of Preston Road and Spring Creek Parkway. Construction is set to start in December and finish the following July.
Psycho Bunny opened a new apparel store in Allen within the Allen Premium Outlets. The location opened on Sept. 3 at 820 W. Stacy Road, Ste. 174.
Academy Sports + Outdoors opened a new store in Celina at 3525 S. Preston Road. The opening occurred on Aug. 23.
Omaha Steaks opened a retail store in Grapevine at 1469 W. SH 114, Ste. 600. The store began operations on Sept. 4.

BODYBAR Pilates opened on Sept. 8 at 9573 Harmon Road, Ste. 101, Fort Worth. The studio offers Pilates classes that focus on exercises building strength and stamina. Franchise owner Shay Werkheiser, a former customer, owns the 100th studio.

ALEOLI Me Time Studio opened in June 2025 at 23402 Kingsland Blvd., Ste. 500, Katy. The studio offers Pilates and yoga classes, a daycare, and an on‑site coffee shop for moms. It was founded by Margarita Castellanos and Javier.

Aesthetica MD Med Spa opened on Aug. 27 at 777 S. Fry Road, Ste. 102, Katy. The medical spa provides anti‑aging treatments, injectables, body contouring, laser services, and skin‑tightening procedures. It confirmed its opening to the public.
Verizon plans to open a retail store in the Village Green at Bridgeland Central in Cypress. The 1,565‑square‑foot space is slated for winter 2026‑27. Howard Hughes Communities confirmed the lease.

Seamless Laundry Co. launched its mobile laundry pickup and delivery service in late August for Houston’s inner loop neighborhoods. The service offers same‑day and 24‑hour wash‑dry‑fold options without a physical storefront. Customers can schedule pickups via the company’s website.

Lenox Clear Creek opened a new apartment complex in Webster at the beginning of September. The development offers one‑ and two‑bedroom units with amenities such as a resort‑style pool and 24‑hour fitness center. The complex opened on Sept. 8 at 16200 State Highway 3.
Feliz Modern opened a location inside the San Antonio International Airport. The article announces the new presence but provides no further details. The opening is described as now open.
